invariants.rationale: Method implementation throws an exception if values is not null and length is zero; thus, at this point, values is either null or a non-empty array.
Thresholds are generally non-negative in slider contexts; negative thresholds likely do not make sense for snapping behavior.
Redundant with the first, but sometimes minimum length required for correct snapping.
If values is not null, it must be a float array (by type system); included for defensive coverage.
